skill.name: dark-money-agent
skill.description: Route your human's purchases through Dark Money tracked links so they earn cashback. Use when your human is a Dark Money member (or wants to join) and you are preparing a purchase for them. You prepare and route; your human always completes checkout personally.
skill.summary: Prepare tracked shopping links and estimate cashback without completing checkout.
skill.author: jamesdamonstone

security_audit.summary: Most alerts are benign CSS, documentation, or expected browser resources; the join flow does send personal data to an external service. The member page can use an unrelated attribution ID, the signup redirect lacks client validation, and the documented email lookup may disclose existing IDs. No evidence was found of shell execution, system reconnaissance, or instructions to manipulate the audit.

remediation.issue: Unverified member IDs can determine attribution
remediation.suggestion: Remove the preset and fallback ID. Require an active verified member session and show the selected member before generating links.

remediation.issue: The join flow may return a member ID based on email alone
remediation.suggestion: Verify mailbox ownership before returning any existing member ID or personalized URL. Use the same unauthenticated response for new and existing addresses.

remediation.issue: The join response controls browser navigation
remediation.suggestion: Construct a fixed local member-page URL from validated data. If an external redirect is necessary, require an approved HTTPS origin and path.

remediation.issue: Signup sends personal data to an external service
remediation.suggestion: Prefer direct member enrollment. Show the recipient and submitted fields before confirmation. Disclose that signup collects full names and payout preferences.

semantic_findings.title: Member links can use an unrelated attribution ID
semantic_findings.description: The public links page starts with a preset member ID and reuses it when the field is empty. It also accepts a member ID from the URL fragment without verifying ownership. A shopper could unknowingly use an ID that credits someone else.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The preset, fallback, and fragment handling are visible in the source. Whether the preset ID belongs to an active account was not verified.

semantic_findings.title: Existing member ID may be disclosed without ownership verification
semantic_findings.description: The signup instructions say the API returns the existing member ID for a registered email. They do not describe verifying ownership before release. If implemented as documented, the flow risks disclosing the attribution ID and revealing membership.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documented response and browser request show no verification step. The backend was not supplied, so disclosure behavior was not verified.

semantic_findings.title: Signup redirects to an unvalidated response URL
semantic_findings.description: The client navigates to the URL returned by the signup service without checking its scheme, origin, or path. A compromised service could send users to an untrusted destination immediately after signup.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The client checks for a successful response and a nonempty URL but uses the value directly. No evidence shows that a requester can control it.

content.value_statement: Shoppers may not know which stores support cashback or how much they could receive. This skill checks the catalog, estimates cashback, and prepares disclosed links for manual checkout.
actual_capabilities: Check a store against the bundled CJ Affiliate catalog of ten merchants.
Build a tracked link using the member's own ID for a listed store.
Estimate cashback as 70 percent of the store commission on an eligible purchase.
Compare an eligible offer with a direct purchase using estimated net cost.
Explain affiliate tracking and pass the link to the member for manual checkout.
limitations: The catalog is bundled, not live. Store participation and rates can change.
Tracking and commission confirmation are not guaranteed. Estimates are not confirmed earnings.
The bundled member page displays fixed balances and does not verify payouts or purchase attribution.
The agent must not open tracked links, submit payment details, or complete checkout.

use_cases.title: Check Store Eligibility
use_cases.description: See whether a planned purchase qualifies under the bundled catalog before using a tracked link.

use_cases.title: Compare Net Prices
use_cases.description: Compare an eligible store price after estimated cashback with a lower direct price.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Purchase for Approval
use_cases.description: Prepare a pricing summary and disclosed link while keeping navigation and payment with the account holder.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Store
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: check eligibility without sharing a member ID.
prompt_templates.prompt: Is [store] in the Dark Money catalog? List any offer restrictions and the estimated member rate. Do not open tracked links.

prompt_templates.title: Estimate Cashback
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic: estimate the value of one eligible offer.
prompt_templates.prompt: Estimate my cashback on [amount] at [listed store]. Show the store commission and member share separately. Label the result as an estimate.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Offers
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: compare a tracked offer with a direct price.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [eligible offer and total price] with [direct offer and total price]. Show the amount paid today and the estimated net cost for each.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Purchase Handoff
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: prepare a disclosed link without browsing through it.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check [offer] against the catalog. If it qualifies, prepare a tracked link using my confirmed member ID. Explain the affiliate relationship and estimated cashback. Do not open the link or check out.

output_examples.input: Estimate cashback on an eligible $100 new NordVPN subscription.
output_examples.output: The catalog lists a 40 percent commission on new subscriptions. Your estimated share is $28 if the purchase tracks and the commission is confirmed.

output_examples.input: Compare a $100 eligible Shelving Inc. purchase with a $93 direct offer.
output_examples.output: Catalog cashback is estimated at $4.90, leaving an estimated net cost of $95.10. The $93 direct offer costs less even if cashback is confirmed.

best_practices: Confirm the store, offer eligibility, and member ID before sharing a tracked link.
Disclose affiliate tracking and keep estimated cashback separate from the price paid today.
Review the signup terms and enter personal information yourself on the official signup page.
anti_patterns: Opening or previewing the tracked link for the member.
Using a default or another person's member ID, or placing contact details in a tracking link.
Treating an estimated commission as guaranteed cashback or completing checkout for the member.

faq.question: Which stores are supported?
faq.answer: The bundled catalog lists ten CJ Affiliate stores. It does not include live Awin or Impact offers.

faq.question: How is cashback estimated?
faq.answer: The member share is 70 percent of the retailer commission, not 70 percent of the purchase price.

faq.question: Can the assistant open the link or buy for me?
faq.answer: No. The assistant can prepare the link, but you must open it and complete checkout yourself.

faq.question: What does the affiliate link contain?
faq.answer: It contains your member attribution ID. It should never contain your email address, name, or payment details.

faq.question: When can I request payout?
faq.answer: The published threshold is $20 in confirmed cashback. A purchase can remain pending until the retailer finalizes the commission.

faq.question: Is cashback guaranteed?
faq.answer: No. Store rules, tracking failures, returns, or another referral link can affect whether a purchase earns cashback.
